title: 2018 AMC 12B Problem 1
statement: Kate bakes a \(20\)-inch by \(18\)-inch pan of cornbread. The cornbread is cut into pieces that measure \(2\) inches by \(2\) inches. How many pieces of cornbread does the pan contain?

solutions.text:
The pan has area \(20\cdot18=360\) square inches, and each piece has area \(2\cdot2=4\) square inches.

The number of pieces is \[ \dfrac{360}{4}=90. \]

Thus, the correct answer is A.
hints: Divide the total area of the pan by the area of one piece
The pan has area \(20\times18\) and each piece has area \(2\times2\)
